title: Buyers and Cellars
start: Speak to Darren Lightfinger in his cellar, accessed through a trapdoor next to a small house just north of the Lumbridge furnace.

items.t: Logs (can be acquired during the quest)

rewards.t: 3 Thieves' guild pamphlets (each granting 175 Thieving for a total of 525 Thieving XP)

steps.t: Talk to Guildmaster Darren Lightfinger in the Thieves' Guild north of the house with a furnace in Lumbridge (enter the trapdoor). [Chat: 2 What are you doing down here? (Skip speech.) › 2 And what is it you need done? (Skip speech) › Accept › 2 No, I think I've got the hang of this. › 1 Yes.]
Talk to Chief Thief Robin, south of Lumbridge Castle inside the castle wall. [Chat: 1 Go ahead.]
p: Robin waiting for you at Lumbridge Castle

steps.t: Talk to Father Urhney in his house to the south in the Lumbridge Swamp. [Chat: 3 Nice chalice. › 3 Can I have a look at it?]

sub.t: If The Restless Ghost has been completed, [Chat: 4 Nice chalice. › 3 Can I have a look at it?]

steps.t: Light a fire outside one of Urhney's windows.
Talk to Urhney and mention the chalice then the fire. [Chat: 3 Nice chalice. › 4 Fire! Fire!]

sub.t: If The Restless Ghost has been completed, [Chat: 4 Nice chalice. › 4 Fire! Fire!]

steps.t: Pickpocket Urhney quickly to get a complex key.

p: A fire lit outside Father Urhney's window
